messages:
kevin-collections: Orion Bridge (acct OB-220) invoice INV-21088 is 41 days overdue. Card declined and AP hasn't responded to dunning emails. Can we consider a short deferral to avoid immediate suspension?

billing-bot: Dunning notice #3 attempted to billing@orionbridge.co at 1773657389. Delivery status: delivered.

lena-sales: Spoke with their VP Ops. They asked for a 45-day deferral (one payment at day 45) because their new PO process just closed. They want an updated invoice showing PO# when they can provide it. They stressed they'll pay if we can avoid cutting access.

sam-finops: Finance prefers a two-part option: (A) single 45-day deferral with 1% recon fee, or (B) 2-installment split (50/50) over 30/60 days with no fee. Both require signed agreement and updated invoice with PO when provided. Need @olivia-fmgr sign-off on fee vs no-fee tradeoff. Also flag: attach last 60d usage CSV to help their AP.

olivia-fmgr: Approve option B (2-installment, no fee) to reduce friction given their ARR band. Condition: first installment must be paid by day 30 or service will be suspended. Approve waiving suspension for initial 30 days while we await the first payment. Legal to sign off on contract language.

marta-legal: I'll prepare a short payment agreement and PO addendum. Need exact billing contact and the PO number once it's available. Will include clause: payment schedule enforcement + proof of PO within 7 days of first payment or revert to standard billing.

kevin-collections: Thanks. I'll create payment_plan_id `PP-17736-OB` and send DocuSign with two installments: 50% due 2026-04-05, 50% due 2026-05-05. Portal link will expire in 6 days. I'll attach usage CSV and the updated invoice template that includes PO field.

billing-bot: Payment plan created: https://pay.redwood.ai/pp/PP-17736-OB (expires in 6 days) (1773700000).

lena-sales: Intro email sent to billing@orionbridge.co and ap@orionbridge.co, cc: legal@orionbridge.co. Asked them to e-sign today and include PO# NL-PO-900 when available.

kevin-collections: Monitoring signs. If no signature in 6 days we'll escalate to managed collections and notify Sales leadership. Will update here when signed or if payment clears.
